result.rationale: The diff contains `const isTeamAdminOrOwner = (await isTeamAdmin(user.id, ...)) && (await isTeamOwner(user.id, ...));`. The variable name says 'AdminOrOwner' but uses &&, so a user who is only a team admin (not owner) gets false, failing the subsequent permission check `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee)` and receiving FORBIDDEN even though an admin should be allowed. The && appears to be a typo for ||.
